articles.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
articles.excerpt: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
articles.summary: 为编程 AI agent 设计的输出风格技能，强制它先抛出结论和关键答案，不再把重点埋在冗长解释与推理过程里，输出对 ADHD 读者更友好。可以 skill 形式接入 Claude Code 等编码 agent，适合讨厌翻长文找答案的开发者。

articles.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
articles.excerpt: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
articles.summary: 浏览器里运行的间谍卫星模拟器，数据却是真实的：在照片级 3D 地球上叠加开源情报，实时查看卫星轨道、影像与地理空间信息。面向 OSINT 研究者、地理信息爱好者，以及想直观理解全球态势的人。

articles.title: obra/superpowers
articles.excerpt: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
articles.summary: 面向 AI agent 的技能框架与配套软件开发方法论，把提示词、技能和工程实践组织成可复用工作流，让 agent 在真实项目中稳定交付。适合想系统化落地 agentic 编码流程的团队与个人开发者。

articles.title: alsk1992/CloddsBot
articles.excerpt: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.

articles.title: Tencent/teamai-cli
articles.excerpt: Make Every Team AI Native
articles.summary: 腾讯开源的命令行工具，目标是让团队研发与协作流程全面 AI 化，把 AI 能力接入日常工程工作流。仓库描述较简短，具体功能需查阅文档；面向希望统一团队 AI 工具链的工程组织。

articles.title: AlexsJones/llmfit
articles.excerpt: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.

articles.title: liquidslr/system-design-notes

articles.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design

articles.title: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC

articles.title: nashsu/llm_wiki
articles.excerpt: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
articles.summary: 跨平台桌面应用，自动把本地文档整理成互相关联、可浏览的知识库，用持续演化的 Wiki 结构替代传统 RAG 的即取即答模式，让知识可积累而非每次重新检索。适合长期管理个人或团队资料的人。

articles.title: vastsa/PI-Desktop

articles.title: From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent

articles.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers

articles.title: BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234

articles.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it

articles.title: Secure all your internal vibe-coded applications — in one click
